title: haven: a leave replayed after its Commit is answered invalidProposal, not wrongEpoch as DIV-10 says
description: Found live (B4 step 4g), Haven 07ce96f. After the room's Commit at epoch 2 removed carol (hub learned epoch 3), resending carol's epoch-2 leave proposal got 200 UpdateRoomResponse invalidProposal 'the participant list update does not fit the room', invalidProposals empty. DIVERGENCES.md DIV-10 L204-205: 'A leave of another epoch is wrongEpoch naming the current one, so proposals sent again after their Commit are refused.' Cause: hold_leave_proposals (mimi-hubd/src/lib.rs ~L1110-1130) checks the removed indices against the current list (index 2 no longer exists) before the epoch. protocol-07 §5.3 L1619-1620: wrongEpoch 'indicates that the hub provider is using a different epoch'. The refusal is still a refusal (nothing held) and mimid decodes it, so this is cosmetic: for Haven, check the epoch before the index (fix), or say in DIV-10 that a replay can be answered invalidProposal (document). Low priority; mention only if convenient.
notes: 2026-11-13: reported to Haven with Mark's OK in https://github.com/havenmessenger/interop/issues/1#issuecomment-6863824360
close_reason: Fixed in Haven 3e2631f; verified 2026-11-13 by the public B4 run against our hub at edd3ba1 (tag t20261113204839): cancel leaves no requested row; replayed leave answers WrongEpoch.
